what: Paired online runs of the PI-atm case: A the original Fortran model, C freeCAM with the Python stage class installed and nothing replaced, in one allocation each. The goal is a median C/A coupling-loop ratio of 0.95 or better over the month and the year, bit-for-bit, on 512 ranks.

c.bfb_note: the job compared C before changing to the checkout and found no verifier; compared afterwards by hand with tools/verify_pi_cam.py against the oracle month
